questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

Statistical __measure which track the money-saving behaviour__ haven’t improved much.

options.text: measures what track the money-saving behaviour
measures which track the money-saving behaviour

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"​measures which track the money-saving behaviour"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the **singular noun** 'measure' is **incorrect**.
 
• The **verbs 'track' and 'haven't'** used in the sentence are in **plural form**.
 
• **Subjects and verbs must agree with one another in number** (singular or plural).
 
• Thus, **if a subject is singular**, **its verb must also be singular**; if a **subject is plural**, its **verb must also be plural**.
 
• Therefore, the **plural form of the noun** 'measure' i.e. 'measures' **should be used with the plural verb** 'track'.
 
• **Hence**, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence__:** *Statistical **measures which track the money-saving behaviour** haven’t improved much.*
